description: This file defines the TaxSettingsClient class, which is used to interact with the AWS Tax Settings service, including methods for various tax registration and exemption management operations.

classes.name: TaxSettingsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Tax Settings service, extending the base AwsClient class and providing methods for tax registration and exemption operations.

methods.name: batchDeleteTaxRegistration
methods.description: Deletes multiple tax registrations in a batch operation.

methods.name: batchGetTaxExemptions
methods.description: Retrieves details of multiple tax exemptions.

methods.name: batchPutTaxRegistration
methods.description: Adds or updates multiple tax registrations.

methods.name: batchPutTaxRegistrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or updates multiple tax registrations.

methods.name: deleteSupplementalTaxRegistrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a supplemental tax registration.

methods.name: getTaxRegistrationDocumentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a tax registration document.

methods.name: putSupplementalTaxRegistration
methods.description: Creates or updates a supplemental tax registration.

methods.name: putSupplementalTaxRegistrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a supplemental tax registration.

methods.name: putTaxExemption
methods.description: Creates or updates a tax exemption.

methods.name: putTaxExemptionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a tax exemption.

methods.name: putTaxInheritance
methods.description: Creates or updates tax inheritance details.

methods.name: putTaxInheritanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates tax inheritance details.

methods.name: putTaxRegistration
methods.description: Creates or updates a tax registration.

methods.name: putTaxRegistrationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a tax registration.
